original_ai_output.title_zh: 上尼罗河大学将在马拉卡勒恢复学院办学
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹公立大学上尼罗河大学表示，已基本完成在马拉卡勒恢复人力资源开发学院教学的准备工作，课程计划于10月第一周开始。该学院因2013年12月爆发的冲突迁至朱巴，目前已有92名学生被录取。校方称部分宿舍被武装部队人员占用，正与州政府协商腾退，并解决水电短缺问题。

location.raw_text: Malakal, the capital of Upper Nile State

key_facts.fact: 上尼罗河大学称已基本完成在马拉卡勒恢复人力资源开发学院教学的准备工作
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Upper Nile University, one of South Sudan’s public universities, says it has completed most preparations to resume teaching at its Human Resource Development College in Malakal

key_facts.fact: 课程计划于10月第一周开始，面向2026-27学年
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Classes are due to begin in the first week of October for the 2026-27 academic year

key_facts.fact: 该学院因2013年12月南苏丹冲突爆发而从马拉卡勒迁至朱巴
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The university was originally based in Malakal but moved operations to Juba after conflict broke out in South Sudan in December 2013

key_facts.fact: 目前已有92名学生被录取
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: So far, 92 students have been admitted, Akuei said

key_facts.fact: 校方称部分宿舍被武装部队人员占用，正与上尼罗河州政府协商腾退
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Some of its dormitories are occupied by members of the organised forces, according to Akuei. He said the university is working with the Upper Nile state government to have the facilities vacated

uncertainties: 校方关于准备工作完成及宿舍腾退进展的说法来自单一来源（Radio Tamazuj），尚未获得独立交叉验证
宿舍被武装部队人员占用的情况为校方官员单方面陈述，未获其他来源确认
